"""Main launches only freshly qualified pristine official cache512 phases."""
import argparse
import contextlib
import hashlib
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import runpy
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
P = B / 'latest-update-pristine-official-cache512-controller-source-v1'
HEALTH = B / 'latest-update-main-provider-health-configured-v1.py'
HEALTH_SHA = '374c6c903b50326a6eba63d913896b48fc34e9a90266f69cc6e1e6bc25c69802'
QUALIFIED = B / 'latest-update-main-cache512-qualification-root-v2/record.json'


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--phase', choices=('startup', 'model'), required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    qualified = json.loads(QUALIFIED.read_text())
    assert qualified['passed'] and qualified['complete'] and not qualified['active']
    assert qualified['main_reviewed'] and not qualified['model_launch_attempted']
    assert qualified['source']['path'] == str(B / 'latest-update-main-cache512-qualification-v2.py')
    assert sha(Path(qualified['source']['path'])) == qualified['source']['sha256']
    q_path = Path(qualified['qualification']['path'])
    q_sha = qualified['qualification']['sha256']
    assert sha(q_path) == q_sha
    q = json.loads(q_path.read_text())
    assert {p.name: sha(p) for p in P.glob('*.py')} == q['controller_source_pins']
    assert sha(HEALTH) == HEALTH_SHA
    health_root = B / ('latest-update-main-provider-health-official-' + args.phase + '-root-v10')
    target_root = B / ('latest-update-main-cache512-' + args.phase + '-health-root-v1')
    assert not health_root.exists() and not target_root.exists()
    sys.argv = [str(HEALTH), '--engine', 'official', '--phase', args.phase, '--serial', '10']
    capture = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(capture):
        try:
            runpy.run_path(str(HEALTH), run_name='__main__')
        except SystemExit as status:
            assert status.code == 0, status.code
    assert len(capture.getvalue().encode()) <= 16384
    fresh_path = health_root / 'record.json'
    fresh = json.loads(fresh_path.read_text())
    assert fresh['passed'] and fresh['complete'] and not fresh['active']
    assert fresh['binary'] == q['engines']['official']['health_binary']
    assert fresh['mapped_libraries'] == q['engines']['official']['health_libraries']
    if args.phase == 'model':
        predecessor = B / 'latest-update-pristine-official-cache512-model-root-v1/official-startup/record.json'
        startup = json.loads(predecessor.read_text())
        assert startup['passed'] and startup['complete'] and not startup['active']
        assert startup['model_normal_close'] and startup['kernel_gate_passed']
        assert not startup['startup_diagnostics']['severe_messages']
        assert not startup['startup_protocol_diagnostics']['severe_messages']
        assert startup['qualification_sha256'] == q_sha
        assert startup['selected_device_stderr_lines']
        stderr = predecessor.parent / 'commands/engine.stderr'
        assert stderr.stat().st_size < 64 << 20
        cache_lines = [line for line in stderr.read_text().splitlines()
                       if re.search(r'PER-LAYER|pre-filled|ranked pairs|expert cache checksum', line)]
        assert len(cache_lines) <= 32 and any('pre-filled' in line for line in cache_lines)
        review_path = B / 'latest-update-main-cache512-startup-review-v1.json'
        assert not review_path.exists()
        review = dict(passed=True, main_reviewed=True, predecessor_sha256=sha(predecessor),
                      compile_diagnostics_reviewed=True, provider_identity_reviewed=True,
                      engine_stderr=dict(path=str(stderr), sha256=sha(stderr)),
                      cache_evidence_lines=cache_lines, effective_info=startup['effective_info'],
                      readback_scope='First ranked profile pair assigned slot only; not every resident slot')
        review_path.write_text(json.dumps(review, indent=2) + '\n')
        fresh['startup_review'] = dict(path=str(review_path), sha256=sha(review_path))
    target_root.mkdir()
    fresh.update(main_health_receipt=dict(path=str(fresh_path), sha256=sha(fresh_path)),
                 main_launcher=dict(path=str(Path(__file__)), sha256=sha(Path(__file__))))
    bound = target_root / 'record.json'
    bound.write_text(json.dumps(fresh, indent=2) + '\n')
    print('FRESH HEALTH PASS official cache512 ' + args.phase, flush=True)
    sys.path.insert(0, str(P))
    sys.argv = [str(P / 'run_root.py'), '--engine', 'official', '--phase', args.phase,
                '--qualification', str(q_path), '--qualification-sha256', q_sha,
                '--fresh-health', str(bound), '--fresh-health-sha256', sha(bound)]
    runpy.run_path(str(P / 'run_root.py'), run_name='__main__')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
